# Cornerstone Jobs Scraper & API - All CSOD Career Sites, Remote

> Cornerstone jobs scraper and API for every company on csod.com, searched live by job title, location, remote and posting date, newest first.

## Summary

Cornerstone Jobs Scraper is an Apify actor that searches every company's career site on Cornerstone OnDemand (csod.com) at once and returns one row per job, newest first: title, company, location, remote flag, posting date, closing date and link. It covers 1,110 career sites of 605 employers and 61,000+ open jobs (2026-10-30), including McDonald's, Henkel, Turner Construction, STRABAG, Linde and Kohler. It reads Cornerstone live at run time with no login and no API key, and 47% of these jobs sit on career sites closed to search engines, so a site:csod.com Google search does not find them. It is built for job seekers and job boards, recruiters, sales and market research teams, and AI agents that need a live feed of Cornerstone jobs. It costs $2.00 per 1,000 jobs, or $3.00 per 1,000 with full details, with no start fee.

Store: https://apify.com/anshumanatrey/cornerstone-jobs-search
Source: https://github.com/AnshumanAtrey/cornerstone-jobs-search

## Use it from an AI assistant

- Claude (claude.ai and the desktop app): https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=Cornerstone%20Jobs&connectorUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmcp.apify.com%3Ftools%3Danshumanatrey%2Fcornerstone-jobs-search (click Continue, sign in to Apify, Allow).
- All 12 job boards at once, one Claude connector for Hiring Cafe, Workday, SmartRecruiters, Greenhouse, Workable, Welcome to the Jungle, Lever, Ashby, Cornerstone, Y Combinator, Wellfound and eFinancialCareers: https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=12%20Job%20Boards&connectorUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmcp.apify.com%3Ftools%3Danshumanatrey%2Fhiringcafe-jobs-search%2Canshumanatrey%2Fworkday-job-search%2Canshumanatrey%2Fsmartrecruiters-jobs-search%2Canshumanatrey%2Fgreenhouse-jobs-search%2Canshumanatrey%2Fworkable-job-search%2Canshumanatrey%2Fwelcome-to-the-jungle-jobs-search%2Canshumanatrey%2Flever-jobs-search%2Canshumanatrey%2Fashby-jobs-search%2Canshumanatrey%2Fcornerstone-jobs-search%2Canshumanatrey%2Fycombinator-jobs-search%2Canshumanatrey%2Fwellfound-jobs-search%2Canshumanatrey%2Fefinancialcareers-jobs-search
- Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http cornerstone-jobs-search "https://mcp.apify.com?tools=anshumanatrey/cornerstone-jobs-search", then /mcp to sign in to Apify.
- Codex: codex mcp add cornerstone-jobs-search --url "https://mcp.apify.com?tools=anshumanatrey/cornerstone-jobs-search", then codex mcp login cornerstone-jobs-search.
- Any other MCP client: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=anshumanatrey/cornerstone-jobs-search, signed in with Apify or Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>.

## Key features

- Every career site at once, with no list of companies needed: 1,110 sites in about a minute.
- One keyword is enough; an empty form returns the newest jobs of every kind.
- Newest first, read live, not from a stored copy.
- Place filter by city, state, country or region: Germany, EMEA, LatAm, Worldwide.
- Reads a pasted Google dork such as site:newcold.csod.com intext:engineer.
- Job link check: each pasted link comes back open, closed or not found.

## Input keys

- Job titles to find (searchTerms): one per line; a job matches when its title has every word.
- Where the job is (location): city, state, country or region.
- Remote or onsite (workType): remote or hybrid, read from the title and location; onsite finds no jobs, because nothing on Cornerstone marks a job as onsite.
- Posted in the last (postedWithin): 24 hours, 3 days, 7 days, 30 days, any time, or your own period.
- Number of jobs (maxJobs): 100 by default, 0 for every match.
- Full details (includeDetails): adds the description, reference, apply link and address; postedAt then holds the time the job's requisition was opened, not the posting date.
- Leave out words (excludeTerms): drops jobs whose title has these words.
- Match descriptions (searchDescriptions): finds your words in the description too.
- Only these companies (companies): a name, the name in the address, or a career-site link.
- Job links to check (jobUrls): checks links instead of searching.

## Output fields

- Every row: title, company, location, otherLocations, workType, postedAt, expiresAt, jobUrl, applyUrl, status, platform, companySlug, jobId, checkedAt.
- With full details (includeDetails): also description, descriptionHtml, reference, city, region, country and countryCode.
- postedAt: in a search, the day the job was posted on the career site (a date, no time). With full details on, and for an open checked link, the date and time the company opened the job's requisition in Cornerstone, which can be far earlier: job 954 at NewCold was dated 2026-07-03 by a search (run takgbge7em1qt4MaA) and 2024-09-09T16:30:28Z by a link check (run E4Fwz4hH7zSid7e92), both on 2026-11-03. In a search, postedWithin and the newest-first order use the posting date, with full details on or off.
- status: open for every search result; for a checked link, open, closed or not found.
- No salary, job type or department fields: Cornerstone does not publish them.
- The OUTPUT record in the default key-value store: career sites read, jobs matched and saved, and notes on how the input was read.
- Export as JSON, CSV or Excel.

## Pricing

PAY_PER_EVENT model, platform usage included, no start fee:

- Job: $0.002 per saved job ($2.00 per 1,000), and per checked link that is closed or not found
- Job with details: $0.003 per saved job with full details on ($3.00 per 1,000)

Discount tiers: the Apify Store header, "from $1.60 / 1,000 jobs", shows the lowest discount-tier price, the GOLD price. FREE (Apify's Free plan) and BRONZE (Starter) pay the base prices above, $0.002 and $0.003; SILVER (Scale) pays 10% less, $0.0018 and $0.0027 ($1.80 and $2.70 per 1,000); GOLD (Business) and the enterprise tiers above it pay 20% less, $0.0016 and $0.0024 ($1.60 and $2.40 per 1,000).

Typical costs (Free and Starter price):

- 100 newest jobs: $0.20
- 100 jobs with full details: $0.30
- 1,000 jobs: $2.00
- 10,000 jobs with full details: $30.00

Apify's free $5 monthly credit covers 2,500 jobs ($5 / $0.002), or 1,666 with full details ($5 / $0.003). Number of jobs (maxJobs) sets the most a run can cost, and a run stops at its spending limit with a message saying so.

## How to run it

Every way takes the same JSON input as the form and an Apify token.

- API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/actors/anshumanatrey~cornerstone-jobs-search/run-sync-get-dataset-items with the header "Authorization: Bearer <token>" and the JSON input as the body. It waits for the run (up to 300 seconds; a search of every career site takes about 70) and returns the rows; add ?format=csv for CSV.
- Python (apify-client 3 or later): run = client.actor("anshumanatrey/cornerstone-jobs-search").call(run_input={"searchTerms": ["software engineer"]}), then client.dataset(run.default_dataset_id).iterate_items(). On apify-client 2.x the run is a dict: run["defaultDatasetId"].
- JavaScript (apify-client): const run = await client.actor('anshumanatrey/cornerstone-jobs-search').call({ searchTerms: ['software engineer'] }), then await client.dataset(run.defaultDatasetId).listItems().
- n8n: the Apify node, Run Actor with the JSON input, then Get Dataset Items with the run's defaultDatasetId; in an n8n AI Agent, the Apify Tool.
- MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=anshumanatrey/cornerstone-jobs-search gives an agent this actor as its own tool (sign in with Apify, or send the token as a Bearer header). On the default server, https://mcp.apify.com, an agent finds it with search-actors and runs it with call-actor.

## Speed

- Every career site: 69 seconds at the default 2 GB of memory (run b24SuuFL58CMyduIh, 2026-10-30, 100 newest jobs).
- Named companies: seconds. Full details add a moment per job.
- An empty form stops reading once maxJobs is filled with jobs dated today: 2 seconds of reading for the default 100 (run 6AFdE5CkCJmIJwNXH, 2026-10-30).

## When to use

- The user wants jobs from employers on Cornerstone OnDemand, or a csod.com jobs API.
- The user wants jobs that a Google site: search misses.
- The user wants a daily feed of new jobs by title, country or region across many large employers.
- The user wants to check whether Cornerstone job links are still open.

## When NOT to use

- The user needs salary, job type or department: Cornerstone does not publish them.
- The user needs only onsite jobs: nothing on Cornerstone marks a job as onsite, so the onsite choice finds none.
- The user needs jobs from another platform: use the sibling actor for it (listed below), or a multi-ATS actor for many platforms in one run.
- The user needs jobs from a company that is not on Cornerstone.

## Common questions

- Is it legal? Cornerstone Jobs Scraper reads public job postings, what each career site shows any visitor, with no login. The user is responsible for how the data is used, including each site's terms and the privacy laws that apply.
- Does it work on the Apify free plan? Cornerstone Jobs Scraper works on the free plan: its $5 monthly credit pays for 2,500 jobs, or 1,666 with full details, and a run that reaches the spending limit stops with the jobs it paid for.
- How often should it run? A daily run of Cornerstone Jobs Scraper with postedWithin set to "24 hours" gives a fresh feed. Cornerstone gives the posting day, not the hour, so 24 hours also keeps the jobs dated the day before: dedupe on jobUrl.
- How to search one company? To search one Cornerstone company, set companies to a name (Henkel), the first words of a name (World Bank finds World Bank Group), the name in the address (henkel) or a career-site link. A name finds every career site of that company, in seconds.
- How to check a list of job links? To check Cornerstone job links, put them in jobUrls, one per line (career-site links or the older JobDetails.aspx links): each comes back open with the job, closed, or not found, and an open job's postedAt is the time its requisition was opened. A closed or not-found link costs one Job ($0.002); a link Cornerstone does not answer is not charged.
- How does it compare with alternatives? Cornerstone Jobs Scraper searches every career site live with no links needed, and the differentiators below compare it with each alternative. A Google site:csod.com search misses the 47% of jobs on career sites closed to search engines.

## Sample input

```json
{
  "searchTerms": ["software engineer"],
  "location": ["Germany", "United States"],
  "postedWithin": "7 days",
  "maxJobs": 100
}
```

## Sample output (one record)

```json
{
  "title": "Senior Project Engineer",
  "company": "NewCold",
  "location": "Breda, NL",
  "otherLocations": [],
  "workType": null,
  "postedAt": "2026-07-03",
  "expiresAt": null,
  "jobUrl": "https://newcold.csod.com/ux/ats/careersite/5/home/requisition/954?c=newcold",
  "applyUrl": "https://newcold.csod.com/ux/ats/careersite/5/home/requisition/954?c=newcold",
  "status": "open",
  "platform": "cornerstone",
  "companySlug": "newcold/5",
  "jobId": "954",
  "checkedAt": "2026-10-30T11:57:07+00:00"
}
```

## Differentiators vs alternatives

- vs gefese/cornerstone-jobs-scraper ($0.0015 per job, needs the career-site links): cheaper per job; this actor needs no links and searches every career site at once.
- vs fantastic-jobs/career-site-job-listing-api ($0.012 per job, $0.01 start): many more platforms from a stored database; this actor costs less per job and reads Cornerstone live.
- vs memo23/career-site-ats-jobs-api ($0.004 per job, $0.03 start): many more platforms; this actor costs less per job and has no start fee.
